summary: Flat kerb backing onto dense bush where cars park, homes 22 m or more across the road.
reasons: Dense bush along the whole kerb side
Cars parked on this kerb in QLD image

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind the van. Homes across the road are 25 m away at 9 m and 22 m away at 42 m; the garage at 40 m is not a dwelling.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a narrow shoulder; cars park on this edge, so a van fits as they do.
drivers.convention: Two cars parked along this kerb in the QLD image; Esri shows none, so parking may be occasional.

flags: Narrow street; passing room beside a parked van is limited
Dwelling 14 m away at the south end (58 m), outside the section
Gate 10 m away, on a side access, not blocking the street
sun_shade: Heavy bush canopy shades the kerb, especially from the east and north.

best_section.where: east kerb just south of the bend, where the parked cars stand
